sources.entry: BookBounty ⚠ - Retrieve missing Readarr books from Library Genesis. MPL-2.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: BookBounty is a Docker-based tool that searches Library Genesis for books missing from a Readarr library and downloads matches.
summary.what_it_does: BookBounty looks for books that Readarr is tracking but does not have, and searches Library Genesis for them. It matches results against Readarr titles and authors using a minimum match ratio (default 90%). It filters downloads by preferred file extensions, with separate lists for fiction and non-fiction, and by language, taken from the Readarr Metadata Profile where possible. Downloads can be saved as single files or in an author/book folder structure. It can run on a schedule set by hour of day, and can trigger a Readarr library scan when downloads finish. Settings are supplied through environment variables, including the Readarr URL and API key, request timeout, thread limit, and an optional sleep interval between downloads.
use_cases: fill gaps in a Readarr ebook library
automatically fetch missing ebooks on a schedule
download fiction or non-fiction books by title and author
organize downloaded books into author folders for Readarr
filter ebook downloads by format such as epub or mobi
how_to_run: Create a docker-compose.yml using the image thewicklowwolf/bookbounty:latest, mapping port 5000, /bookbounty/config, /bookbounty/downloads and /etc/localtime.
Set environment variables such as readarr_address, readarr_api_key, libgen_address and sync_schedule as needed.
Open the web interface on port 5000.
notable: Can be scheduled to run at set hours of the day, with a deadband of up to 10 minutes from the start time
Two Readarr integration modes: mapping downloads straight into the main Readarr folder, or using an unprocessed folder with manual import
Can trigger a Readarr library scan automatically after downloads complete
Separate preferred extension lists for fiction and non-fiction searches
caveats: The only supported libgen_address URL is stated in the README, and the README does not say which other URLs are supported
Readarr does not rename files on import, so the Rename Files function may be needed afterwards
In the unprocessed-folder mode, some files may need manual import into Readarr
